summary: All 30 requirements PASS. The V5 Skill documentation successfully guided the Agent to produce correct, complete architecture documentation for Flask: 4 DETAIL files with all required four-section format, proper HTML comment markers, dynamic token budgets (2714→10856 through 88609→50000), function-level dependencies from get_function_deps integrated into 依赖关系 sections, and an INDEX with Mermaid dependency graph, functionally-named module summaries, and [→ DETAIL] navigation links at exactly 80% source coverage. Two minor improvements worth making: (1) MCP update_index writes module_count: 3 for a 4-module project — minor mcp_code bug to fix. (2) Phase 3 was executed sequentially rather than with parallel sub-agents as specified — acceptable outcome but Skill docs should explicitly permit sequential execution for small codebases to match agent behavior.
